stem: A patient returns medication that the pharmacy dispensed in error. Select all supported actions.

choices.text: Accept the returned medication under the error pathway.
Place sealed containers directly back on the shelf.
Quarantine it and arrange proper disposal rather than returning it to saleable inventory.
Resell the medication after changing the patient label.
Refuse the return because all dispensed drugs are categorically excluded.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A pharmacy accepts medication it dispensed in error or that is suspected defective or contaminated, but may not return it to inventory and must quarantine and properly dispose of it.

choice_analysis.D: This statement imports Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This statement imports Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
